title: Magnificent Watercolor for Procreate
author: SofydollDesigns
description:
A complete set consisting of 40 brushes; from texturized watercolors to delicate washes – Magnificent Watercolor offers a brush for every need. Each brush was handcrafted by me (and tested by fellow artists) to give you the best experience in creating traditional watercolor art right on your iPad.
You will receive:
40 Watercolor Brushes
3 Canvas Textures (in one Procreate file)
HOW TO IMPORT PROCREATE BRUSHES, PAPER TEXTURES, COLOR PALETTES. Once you download the zipped file; unzip and double click on the brush set to automatically import into Procreate. The paper textures and color palettes work the same way.
FOR PROCREATE ONLY. You’ll need the latest of version of Procreate (5.2). Brushes are not suitable for other programs and applications.
Software/Hardware Needed to Use Brushes: PROCREATE iPhone or iPad / iPad Pro Apple Pencil
